body:
ROOT CAUSE (proved, read-only on VM 108, 14 Nov 2026; 8 live Deezer look-ups made by me, no write anywhere).
FUNNEL. Navidrome 0.64.2 has 1060 artists; 150 of them are the joined-name rows of B-119/N-10 (artist.* "skipped", no album, not in getArtists). getArtists lists 910: 810 with coverArt, 100 without (the phone's 91 of 817 after its own filter). The 100 = the 100 artists whose item_artwork row shows upload/artist.*/album-artist.*/external:deezer all "miss". All 100 have kept files under Encore/ (97 only there, 3 also elsewhere); none has a ref with a deezer_id (97 only a YouTube id, 3 neither).
WHY (Navidrome v0.64.2 adapters/deezer/deezer.go, read on GitHub): its ONLY keyless artist-picture source is a Deezer search by NAME. (a) 80 of 100: it needs strings.EqualFold(deezerName, ourName): "Bob Marley" (Deezer: "Bob Marley & The Wailers", 12.3M fans), "Jay-Z" ("JAY Z"), "Jimi Hendrix Experience" ("The Jimi Hendrix Experience"), uploaders/labels (KEXP, ARTE Concert, Crunchyroll, Earache Records), non-Latin names; all logged "Artist not found in deezer". (b) 20 of 100 (Bring Me The Horizon, System Of A Down, Mac Miller, Kings Of Leon, Queens Of The Stone Age, Goo Goo Dolls and 13 more): NOT in that log. rank() puts the exact-CASE namesake first, before fan count; Deezer has a 1-fan placeholder-picture namesake ("Mac Miller" 1 fan vs "MAC MILLER" 1,292,144 fans; "Kings Of Leon" 1 fan vs "Kings of Leon" 2,400,636), and the placeholder is dropped only AFTER choosing, so it ends as a silent ErrNotFound. Navidrome then remembers the miss (item_artwork.attempted_at, 7 Nov; not retried in 7 days).
B-112's stated cause (songs from the catalogue/YouTube have no picture) is wrong: 811 artists whose files are all kept under Encore/ DO have pictures.
FIX (design decided with the advisor): a server-side artist-picture finder next to cover_finder.py: identify the artist by one of ITS OWN SONGS (Deezer track search "artist title", accept only a hit whose title matches and whose artist is ours or has ours as lead name), take that hit's artist picture (placeholder dropped before choosing), write artist.jpg into the artist's own kept folder Encore/<Artist>/ (Navidrome's second picture source; a Host's own upload/artist.jpg still wins), ask for a scan (existing hook), remember a miss per artist for a window, a Deezer timeout/throttle is NOT a miss. No phone change, no new screen: coverArt arrives through getArtists and the existing ticket path.
NOT COVERED by this fix, on purpose: artists whose files are outside Encore/ (the person's own music is never written to; 3 of 100 here). Proper follow-up = upload through Navidrome's native POST /api/artist/{id}/image (exists in 0.64.2). Also seen, not N-15: imported YouTube videos are saved with the UPLOADER CHANNEL as the artist (KEXP "Tinariwen - Full Performance (Live on KEXP)", ARTE Concert, Crunchyroll, label channels): such names must never get a picture; the importer should read "Artist - Title". For the lead: upstream fix is in Navidrome's rank() (fans before exact case; drop placeholders before ranking); outward-facing, yours to decide.
